points.point: The company recognized a net gain of approximately $240 million from an interchange fee litigation settlement as a reduction of selling, general, and administrative expenses.
points.quote: The Company recognized a gain of approximately $ 240 million, net of approximately $ 60 million of legal expenses, in the thirteen and thirty-nine weeks ended October 31, 2026, which was recorded as a reduction of selling, general and administrative expenses in the consolidated statements of operations.
